title: Prove the full affine-reader floor for four fixed non-Fano queries
body:
## Summary

```text
four fixed query slots: a+b, a+c, b+c, a+b+c
arbitrary readers over characteristic != 2
  -> complete affine parameter w
  -> exact ternary support specialization, including external ports
  -> 800 plane classes / 4,960 literal target triples
  -> minimum bill never below the original; six equality triples
```

Close the arbitrary-reader question above PR3515 for this fixed dictionary and Tekalign's PR3370 partition. Zero readers are allowed. The previous one-port family's best bill 20 can fall to 16 when every port varies, but the original bill is also 16. This is a scoped computer-assisted obstruction. Other rays, query deformations and geometries remain open; no supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Retain the actual inherited PR3515 proof and PR3370 partition bytes with exact origin commit/path/blob/SHA256. Canonical labels are pinned at `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`. Comparisons are separate from proof premises and runtime inputs. Credit Tekalign, Philippe Van Velzen, Arham Tahir/PR3345, DreamingOfClouds and the retained P112/E8/native/compiler/supplier lineage.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3515 covers 52,080 one-port switches, best 20 versus 16; arbitrary w remained unpriced.
  **After:** an algebraic support reduction covers every coefficient choice in every characteristic other than two. Exact minimization covers 1,084,757,832 assignments across 4,960 triples, with six equalities and no saving.
- Registered CPython 3.12 optimized replay passes. The separate implementation imports no primary code, uses raw rectangular Gram columns and solves every triple without the primary symmetry shortcut. Both streams agree on `0bbb26534e8d8b663647d16b2c063c0bed5a0305e6e4a1989f6e5292fdb8e160`.
- All 12,544 literal witness entries pass. Five actual optimized CLI corruptions reject, followed by a restored positive case. Ruff diagnostics, metadata/pins, committed-byte/source-history checks, official export validation and all committed Git-free commands pass with unchanged sources.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-nonfano-affine-reader
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p112-nonfano-affine-reader --check-source-history
```

The proof is author-checked. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Native acquisition, scalar execution, frames, arbitrary dirty restoration, hosting, stock, precision, physical consumers, all-size/compiler and outer theorem obligations remain. The selected full cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run for this isolated package; hosted CI is outside the reported evidence.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way

**Blast Radius:** Research

Twelve new files in one package. Existing selected records, frozen inputs and shared replay code are unchanged.
